standingLines.line: ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.
📺 RATINGS SUMMONS — the numbers are soft and the System is nervous.
📺 ● LIVE — Ratings Summons. YOU is on television.

📺 The brief: a promo stunt, live, sixty seconds, for the ratings. The System suggests interpretive dance about the food supply. The chat suggests worse.

Your body is the budget. Your dignity is the marketing spend.
📈 your showbiz fans +3 — ratings stunt (favor: 3)

📺 The Guest. An alien ambassador is coming to dinner at your haven. Televised. Serve something it finds interesting, and survive an etiquette you were never taught.

People have been hurt in this one. Not always.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A ship the size of weather settles over the haven. Out steps the ambassador: too many limbs, impeccable manners, and a retinue of cameras.

It is coming to DINNER. At your table. Tonight.

Nobody knows what it eats. The veterans who've hosted before just smile tightly and say "you'll see."
📺 Your finest stew, the good bowls, the good spoons. It looks like a feast. The ambassador regards it the way you'd regard a dare.

💛 You hold Seed packet. Pressed into your hand with an order: keep people fed through winter. Seeds are a plan. Plans are how you stop being helpless. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

📺 "But real talk? The next act needs a BIGGER STAGE. I can't stage it with ONE fire — there's not enough of you to REFLECT, you feel me? Get me STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread. Rack up the kills, season your alliances, or feast like legends. Make it worth escalating."

📺 The Echo. One witness, two tellings. The story of last night, told at dawn and told at noon — and the details moved between tellings. Find what the teller added for the cameras.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

Silas saw something last night at the far traps. Told it twice.

DAWN: "It was big. I heard it breathing. I hid. I don't know what it was."

NOON: "It was BIG — came right at the traps, I stood my ground, it saw me and turned. I think I scared it."

🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.

📺 The Alibi Chain. Five villagers, each vouched for by the next, a chain that ends at midnight. One link is false. Break the chain before the chain breaks the village.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

The chain, read aloud:

Grace vouches for Gaber. Gaber vouches for Suleiman. Suleiman vouches for Elijah. Elijah vouches for Tariq.

One of those vouches is a lie. The System: "FIND THE FALSE LINK BEFORE MIDNIGHT. THE VILLAGE SLEEPS UNDER WHATEVER YOU LEAVE STANDING."

📺 The Iron Pantry. An alien vault-lock on a full pantry. Five tumblers, one hour of air. Pick it and the village eats. Jam it and the cameras watch you starve politely.

Almost nobody walks away from this one.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A vault door the size of weather. Behind a glass panel: a full pantry — grain, smoked meat, winter itself, stacked and lit like a museum.

Five tumblers. One hour of air in the anteroom. The System, almost gentle: "PICK IT. EAT. THE CAMERAS LOVE HUNGER."
